title: Cicada 3301 as an intelligence recruitment puzzle

tellings.quote: And a lot of people think that the whole puzzle was set up by the NSA or CIA and it was like a recruitment tool.

plain: Cicada 3301, a mysterious puzzle posted on the internet around 2014, was set up by the NSA or the CIA as a way to recruit people, and Michels says many people think so. He mentions the idea himself, without naming a source. If true, it would mean intelligence agencies were using public codebreaking games to find talent.
